Title: General availability: Azure mobile app for Android and iOS

Body.Content:
Stay connected to your Azure resources—anytime, anywhere. By using the Azure mobile app, you can monitor your most important Azure resources and quickly take action to manage them.

For more information about the general availability of the Azure mobile app, see the full blog post.

To download the app on your Android or iOS device, go to the product webpage.
